# Model Evaluation (measured — generated by `python scripts/train.py`, seed 42)

Dataset: 5 000 synthetic tickets → train 3 500 / val 750 / test 750 (stratified on `escalated`).
All numbers below are the actual validation-split outputs in `models/metrics.json`.

## 1. Issue classification (TF-IDF 1–2 grams, max 8k features)
| model | accuracy | precision (macro) | recall (macro) | F1 (macro) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LogisticRegression (balanced) | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | **1.000** |
| LinearSVC (balanced) | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | **1.000** |

Selected: **logreg** (tie → first). Confusion matrix is diagonal on the val split
(see `models/metrics.json`).

> Interpretation: perfect scores are expected — synthetic messages are generated from
> distinct per-category templates, so classes are near-linearly separable. On real
> data these numbers would be lower; the value here is the *comparison harness*
> (accuracy/precision/recall/F1 + confusion matrix), not the absolute score.

## 2. Escalation prediction (XGBoost, 300 trees, depth 5, lr 0.05, scale_pos_weight 2.70)
| precision | recall | F1 | ROC-AUC | PR-AUC |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.726 | 0.847 | **0.782** | **0.946** | **0.875** |

Confusion matrix (rows actual, cols predicted): `[[482, 65], [31, 172]]`.
Recall (0.847) exceeds precision (0.726) — the preferred trade-off for escalation
triage, where missing a true escalation costs more than a false alarm.

## 3. Sentiment
Primary documented model: `distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english` (SST-2).
Shipped fallback: TF-IDF + LogisticRegression trained on the synthetic tickets
(`models/sentiment.joblib`), used by default so the app runs offline; plus a
lexical heuristic as a last resort. Provider is reported in every response.

## 4. Explainability
SHAP `TreeExplainer` when the `shap` package is installed; otherwise a documented
fallback weights global XGBoost gain by per-case feature magnitude. API field
`important_factors` always returns ≤4 entries.

## 5. Methodology notes
- Splits are stratified and seeded; text vectorisers are fit on train only.
- `resolution_time_hours` excluded from escalation features (leakage).
- RAG is evaluated qualitatively (citation presence, "don't know" behaviour), not
  with invented retrieval scores.
